text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for traffic calming, specifically, speed humps on Hanson Street, between Coxwell Avenue and Hillingdon Avenue, to address residents' concerns regarding vehicle speeds. Our assessment indicates that the criteria as set out in the traffic calming policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, traffic calming should not be installed on the subject section of Hanson Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. The Acting Director of Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District to request the City Clerk to poll eligible householders on Hanson Street Avenue between Coxwell Avenue and Hillingdon Avenue, to determine whether residents support the installation of traffic calming, in accordance with the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the poll, the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Hanson Street Avenue between Coxwell Avenue and Hillingdon Avenue, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the copy of Drawing No.421G-2961, dated April, 2018, attached to the report entitled "Traffic Calming (Speed Humps) – Hanson Street" from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
